anomalies.observed: In the Water Level Sensor/Switches section, PR1 (LiDAR) is drawn connected to H1 and carries the global labels +5V, GND, I2C_SCL, I2C_SDA, and EZO_PDIS. Unlike the optional PR5/PR6 sensors, PR1 is not crossed out or marked DNP.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that PR1 is documented but not implemented in the r2 design: its pins are free/on_board no and it is not connected to any net.

evidence.quote: Water Level Sensor/Switches: PR1 LiDAR connected to H1 PB_1.25mm with labels I2C_SCL, I2C_SDA, EZO_PDIS (page 1).
the r2 netlist shows PR1 with on_board: no, in_bom: yes, and all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free — i.e., it is not connected to any net in this design.

anomalies.impact: If built as drawn, an unintended LiDAR module is connected to the main I2C bus and to the EZO_PDIS control net, changing bus loading/addresses and possibly interfering with the isolator power-disable function.

anomalies.observed: The ATO Valve section shows the low-side valve switch as T5 A03400A, while T3 AON6407 appears in the Power Train reverse-polarity position.
anomalies.expected: The specification identifies T3 — AON6407 as the ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch.

evidence.quote: ATO Valve: ATO_VALVE -> R10 -> T4 -> T5 A03400A (page 1 bottom).
T3 — AON6407 ... ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch

anomalies.impact: The ATO valve is driven by a different MOSFET than intended, with a lower voltage rating, reducing margin against inductive transients on the 24 V valve load and potentially causing premature failure.
